title: Sum a List
description: Write a function that takes a list of numbers and returns their total sum. Do not use Python's built-in sum() function.
instructions: Implement sum_list so it iterates through the list and adds up all the numbers.
hints: Start with a variable set to zero to keep track of your running total.
Loop through each number in the list and add it to your total.
Return the total after the loop finishes. Don't forget the empty list case.
